irrBullet 0.1.8, from irrBulletSDK-0.1.8.7z
(sourceforge.net/projects/irrbullet).

Only source/*.h and source/*.cpp are included. The Bullet 2.77 headers
the SDK bundles in source/bheaders are left out; the build uses
../bullet-2.77 instead, the same Bullet version. No source file is
altered.

GameCore replaces kinematiccharactercontroller.h and .cpp with its own
versions when it builds this library (see the game's CMakeLists.txt).
